csv_project_name: Engineering Services for North Belair Road Widening
csv_scope_of_work: The proposed project (Columbia County PI 0021741) consists of widening an approximately 2.4-mile section of North Belair Road (CR 580) from two lanes to three lanes, extending from Evans to Locks Road to SR 28 (Fury's Ferry Road). To improve corridor-wide safety and operational efficiency, the project will feature one mainline travel lane in each direction, a continuous central turning lane, and select right-turn deceleration lanes designed to effectively separate turning movements from through traffic at high-volume side streets. A key component of this corridor modernization is the installation of a shared-use path, which will provide vital multimodal connectivity for cyclists and pedestrians between the Fury's Ferry Road (SR 28) corridor and Evans Town Center. The project scope also encompasses all associated infrastructure and safety upgrades at the CSX railroad crossing. The selected consultant will be responsible for delivering all project phases including concept development, field surveys/database establishment, environmental documentation, public involvement support, preliminary construction plans, subsurface utility engineering (SUE), active utility coordination and relocation management (GDOT Chapter 14 compliance), right-of-way plans, and final construction plans in strict accordance with current GDOT policies, guidelines, and the Plan Development Process (PDP).

short_description: Design services for widening North Belair Road with multimodal and railroad crossing improvements.

services: Full engineering design services for all project phases including concept development, field surveys/database establishment, environmental documentation, public involvement support, preliminary construction plans, subsurface utility engineering (SUE), utility coordination and relocation management, right-of-way plans, and final construction plans in accordance with GDOT policies and PDP.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a roadway widening project rather than a bridge or special structural project.
- Includes a shared-use path and railroad crossing upgrades, but no bridge, long-span, or architecturally demanding structure is described.
- Scope is focused on multidisciplinary roadway engineering and utility/right-of-way coordination, which is only marginally aligned with sbp's core strengths.
- No notable sustainability, lightweight structural, or innovative structural component is stated.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Available cost basis: total construction cost is 23.3 million USD for a 2.4-mile roadway widening with multimodal path, railroad crossing upgrades, utility coordination, ROW plans, and full GDOT plan development.
references_qualifications: All disciplines requested. The selected consultant must be capable of delivering all project phases under current GDOT policies, guidelines, and PDP, including environmental documentation, surveys, SUE, utility coordination/relocation management, right-of-way plans, and final construction plans. DBE participation goal: 15%.
